en.title: Messages
en.emptyBody: Quotes, bookings and messages for your tasks show up here.
en.pickThread: Choose a conversation to read it.
en.lockedNotice: You can message here once a quote is accepted.
en.notSelectedNotice: This task went to another worker, so the conversation is closed to you.
en.systemNotice: Announcements from Slashie. You can't reply here.
en.blockedNotice: You blocked {name}. Unblock them to send messages.

zh_hk.title: 訊息
zh_hk.emptyBody: 你任務的報價、預約及訊息會在這裡顯示。
zh_hk.lockedNotice: 報價被接受後，你就可以在這裡傳送訊息。
zh_hk.notSelectedNotice: 此任務已交給另一位工作者，你無法再參與這段對話。
zh_hk.systemNotice: 這是 Slashie 的公告，你無法在此回覆。
zh_hk.blockedNotice: 你已封鎖 {name}。解除封鎖後才可傳送訊息。
